## TL;DR

<C id="drains">Every queued microtask runs before the next task</C>, so `Promise.then` beats `setTimeout(cb, 0)`. Use a microtask when order matters.

The engine resolves container size first, e.g. during layout. It then evaluates the rules.

<Advice>Prefer `queueMicrotask()` for this. <C id="qm-same-queue">It uses the same queue as promise reactions.</C></Advice>

Call `obj.method(). then` chains. <C id="other-page/x">One sentence. Two sentences.</C> Three.
